segments.say: A scam victim's money lands in a mule account.
Within minutes, it is moving on through other accounts.
The question for an investigator: which few accounts do you freeze, without locking out everyone else?
Chokepoint is an investigation agent on Falkor D B.
It opens a case from an alert, works out what could still move, and builds a freeze plan.
The model chooses the tools. It never writes a query, and every number on the cards comes from a tool.
For this alert, up to twenty-two thousand dollars could still reach accounts three hops away.
That is a ceiling taken from past transfers, not a forecast.
Freezing these three accounts cuts every route.
Then it checks.
It deletes those accounts from a copy of the graph, and searches again for a route. None is left.
A second check re-reads the source graph, and has to agree.
It is a consistency check on the same data, and the card says so.
The plan comes from a max flow inside Falkor D B.
While building this, we found that Falkor D B's max flow is sometimes wrong.
On this small network it answers three hundred. The true answer is four hundred fifty-three.
So no answer is trusted until it is proven.
When the proof fails, the flow is repaired inside Falkor D B, and proven again.
Against the usual rule of thumb, freezing whoever the account paid most recently, this plan blocks about the same share of escaped money.
I am not claiming more. This example was picked because the rule leaves money movable; the typical result is a tie.
What the plan adds is a guarantee. That rule needs more accounts to leave no route in sixty-four percent of cases.
And its picks are more precise.
A person approves, not the agent.
The order is recorded in the graph, tied to the checked plan by a hash.
Then Chokepoint acts. Holds are placed on the accounts, and a freeze request is filed, with the exact queries and both checks attached.
In this recording, GitHub is a local stand-in. No bank is called.
Every answer has a receipt, and the receipts are chained.
This button recomputes every hash, here in the browser. Change one stored value, and the check fails at that record.
Cases persist, so an investigation can be resumed later.
It is not locked inside this screen. Any M C P client can connect to the same nine tools.
There is no tool to approve or dispatch. Only a person can.
Synthetic data. Honest numbers. Everything checkable.
Chokepoint: which accounts do you freeze, and can you prove it?
